about.title: About FreshFruit
about.subtitle: Your Trusted Wholesale Fruit Supplier Since 2012
about.description: FreshFruit specializes in providing fresh, high-quality local fruits to retailers, stores, and businesses. With over 12 years of experience, we've built strong relationships with trusted farmers and suppliers to ensure every fruit meets our strict quality standards.
about.mission: FreshFruit's mission is to provide fresh local fruits at competitive wholesale prices, supporting retailers and stores in developing efficient businesses.

whyChoose.title: Why Choose FreshFruit?
whyChoose.subtitle: Reasons that make FreshFruit the top choice for retailers and stores

item1.question: Why choose FreshFruit's wholesale fruits?
item1.answer: FreshFruit specializes in providing fresh local fruits from famous regions of Vietnam. Each product is carefully selected for quality and freshness, suitable for wholesale and retail business.

item2.question: How does FreshFruit ensure product quality?
item2.answer: We have a strict quality control process from sourcing to delivery. All products have clear origin and food safety assurance.

item3.question: Does FreshFruit offer delivery to retailers?
item3.answer: Yes, we provide same-day delivery service to retailers, stores, and businesses. Careful packaging ensures fruits remain fresh when they reach customers.

item4.question: What is FreshFruit's return policy?
item4.answer: If you're not satisfied with product quality, we will replace or refund within 24 hours of delivery. Special support for long-term retailers.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions

q1.question: Are your fruits fresh?
q1.answer: Yes, we source directly from partner farms daily. All fruits are thoroughly inspected for quality and freshness before delivery to wholesale customers.

q2.question: Do you deliver to retailers?
q2.answer: Yes, we provide delivery service to retailers, stores and businesses. Same-day delivery for orders placed before 12 PM. Delivery fees are calculated based on distance and quantity.

q3.question: What are your wholesale prices?
q3.answer: We offer competitive wholesale prices for retailers. Prices are adjusted based on order quantity and purchase frequency. Please contact us for detailed pricing.

q4.question: Do you have return policy for retailers?
q4.answer: Yes, we have flexible return policy for retailers. If not satisfied with product quality, please contact us within 24 hours for exchange or refund support.

q5.question: Do you provide consultation for new retailers?
q5.answer: Yes, we have professional consultation team to support new retailers with storage, display and fruit business advice. We also provide detailed guidance materials.

refund.title: Refund:

hero.title: Privacy Policy

commitment.title: PRIVACY COMMITMENT
commitment.description: {storeName} does not sell, share or exchange customer personal information collected on the website to any third party. Personal information collected will only be used internally.

section1.title: 1. Purpose and Scope of Information Collection
section1.intro: FreshFruit does not sell, share or exchange customer personal information collected on the website to any third party. Personal information collected will only be used internally.

collected.title: When you provide information to us, the personal information we collect includes:
collected.name: Customer Name

usage.title: This information will be used for one or all of the following purposes:
usage.notification: Notify about delivery and customer support
usage.orderProcessing: Process orders and provide services as requested

section2.title: 2. Scope of Information Use
section2.description: Personal information collected will only be used internally. We may share your name and address with courier services or our suppliers to deliver products to you.

section3.title: 3. Information Storage Time
section3.computerData: We store information for 2 years (computer data).
section3.personalData: For personal information, we only delete this data upon customer request.

section4.title: 4. Address of Personal Information Collection and Management Unit

section5.title: 5. Tools for Users to Access and Edit Personal Data
section5.description: Users can log into their personal account on the website and use the "Edit" function to adjust or delete their personal data. Or contact {storeName} directly to edit or delete.

section6.title: 6. Commitment to Customer Personal Information Security
section6.intro: At {storeName}, the privacy of our visitors is extremely important.
section6.policy: We will not share your information with any other company except companies and third parties directly related to the delivery of products you purchased at {storeName}. In some special cases, we may be required to disclose personal information, for example when there is a basis for disclosure to prevent threats to life and health, or for law enforcement purposes. We are committed to complying with the Privacy Act and National Privacy Principles.
section6.contact: If you believe your privacy has been violated, please contact us at {email} to resolve the issue.
